title: A part added to a paid work order goes on a new one at the current tier
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'View and Manage AP/AR Data', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 10.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier B, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 20.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, made after customer A's tier was set, with one labor line (line 1), invoiced and paid in full.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer A's page from Customers.
  2. Click the edit pencil on the customer card.
  3. Open the Work Order Tier picker.
  4. Pick tier B.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Open work order 1.
  7. Click Add Part under line 1.
  8. Type a description in Description (for example Test part).
  9. Type 1 in Qty.
  10. Pick category A in Category.
  11. Type 100.00 in Cost.
  12. Click Save.
  13. Open customer A's newest work order from the Work Orders list.
  14. Open work order 1.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer A's page opens.

Step 2:

  • Edit Customer opens.

Step 3:

  • The picker lists tier B.

Step 4:

  • Work Order Tier reads tier B.

Step 5:

  • Customer A is saved on tier B.

Step 6:

  • Work order 1 opens, its invoice paid.

Step 7:

  • A new part row opens under line 1 with Part number, Description, Qty, Category, Cost and Sell price boxes and Save and Cancel.

Step 8:

  • Description holds the typed text.

Step 9:

  • Qty holds 1.

Step 10:

  • Category shows category A.

Step 11:

  • Cost holds 100.00 as typed.

Step 12:

  • The part is saved, and a new work order with its own number is made for customer A for it, as happens today when a line is added to a paid work order.

Step 13:

  • The new work order opens with a number other than work order 1's, status Approved, and the new part on it.
  • The new part's sell price is $108.00, tier B's price, customer A's current tier ($135.00 × 0.80 = $108.00).
  • It is not $121.50, the tier A price work order 1 kept ($135.00 × 0.90 = $121.50).

Step 14:

  • Work order 1 opens with its own lines and paid invoice as before, without the new part.
